# Pass 4 — UI

**Goal:** The template renders the logic with our design system. Skip when
there is no UI.

## Do

- Template with spartan components and Tailwind; selector prefixes per
  `conventions › Naming`.
- Confirm installed components and selectors with the spartan CLI/info; never
  guess them. Open the matching `spartan` rule file for what you build.
- Built-in `variant` / `size` and semantic colors before custom classes.
- Read state from the vm directly in the template.
- New or changed texts: only in `en.json` (`conventions › Translations`); leave
  other locale files untouched and mention the new keys in the hand-off.
- A style file only when really needed, and then `.css`.

## Check before moving on

- Every state from pass 3 is visible in the UI (loading, error, empty).
- Icon-only buttons have an accessible label.
